idea-design.en: Titles cluster around playful design experiments: a game timeline, single-file clocks, an ancient Rome builder, synthesized soundscape and multiplayer minigames, showing strong interest in inventive design projects.
idea-design.zh: 多个标题集中展示创意设计实验：游戏时间线、单文件时钟、古罗马建造、合成音景与多人大亨小游戏，体现设计灵感作品受关注。
